reuse.why: Reuses the existing linked-account query (renamed to return ids) and db.updateAccount, but copies the local-unlink field reset from unlinkAccount instead of extracting it into a helper both could call.

duplication.why: The eight-field reset (account_id, bank, balances, sync source, sync status set to null) is a verbatim copy of the block in unlinkAccount, so the definition of an unlinked account now lives in two places.

placement.why: The flag and the takeover live in linkBankAccount in accounts/app.ts, the shared path every provider link goes through, which is the right layer.

scope.why: Only the link query, linkBankAccount and a release note change; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Small and readable, but a future change to what 'unlinked' means must be made in both unlinkAccount and the takeover loop.

bypasses_abstraction.where: unlinkAccount cannot be called as-is because it may contact GoCardless; the diff copies its local reset rather than going around a shared local-unlink helper (none exists).

disguised_duplication.where: The copied db.updateAccount reset in linkBankAccount is a literal copy of unlinkAccount's, not reshaped.
